headline: Names the Postal Service facility at 110 East Powerhouse Road in Collegeville, Minnesota, the "Eugene J. McCarthy Post Office."
what_it_does: This law officially gives a name to a post office building in Collegeville, Minnesota. The building is now called the Eugene J. McCarthy Post Office. The law does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 29, 2016.
